owner.description: Owner does the action, when it is not the step's owner.

text.description: Text says what to do, in Markdown.

command.description: Command is shell to run, shown as a code block.

link.description:
Link points into another page, resolved when the runbook is
rendered, and is shown after the text.

Action.description: Action is one thing to do: a command to run, or an instruction.

id.description: ID is unique within the step.

kind.description: Kind names the check and the field holding its parameters.

dns.description: DNS holds a dns check's parameters.

http.description: HTTP holds an http check's parameters.

unreachable.description: Unreachable holds an unreachable check's parameters.

command.description: Command holds a command check's parameters.

named.description: Named holds a named check's parameters.

Check.description: Check proves part of a step is done.

args.description: Args are the command and its arguments, run without a shell.

contains.description: Contains, when set, must be in the command's standard output.

CommandCheck.description: CommandCheck passes when the command exits 0.

type.description: Type is A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS or TXT.

contains.description:
Contains are substrings, each found in at least one answer, such as
"ns.cloudflare.com" for a zone on Cloudflare.

DNSCheck.description: DNSCheck passes when a lookup returns an answer containing each wanted string.

method.description: Method is the request's method; GET when empty.

contains.description: Contains, when set, must be in the body.

location.description: Location, when set, must prefix the Location header of a redirect.

HTTPCheck.description: HTTPCheck passes when a request returns the status, without following redirects.

needs.description: Needs says what it takes, in Markdown.

Later.description: Later is work after the runbook, for the closing table.

key.description:
Key names the target for the renderer's resolver, such as
"plan:payments"; Href is used when it is empty.

href.description: Href is a fixed target, relative to the rendered page.

Link.description: Link is a link resolved when the runbook is rendered, so a section renumbered in a generated page cannot break it.

name.description: Name is the registered check, such as "aws.s3-bucket".

NamedCheck.description: NamedCheck runs a check registered in Go.

id.description: ID is the phase's number, such as "0".

title.description: Title names the phase, such as "Prepare".

gives.description: Gives is what finishing the phase gives, for the summary table.

summary.description: Summary introduces the phase, in Markdown.

steps.description: Steps are done in order, unless their dependencies say otherwise.

Phase.description: Phase groups steps toward one result.

id.description: ID names the runbook, such as "launch".

summary.description: Summary introduces the runbook, in Markdown.

usage.description: Usage explains how to use the runbook, in Markdown.

later.description: Later is work that follows the runbook, listed at the end.

Runbook.description: Runbook is an ordered procedure: phases of steps.

id.description: ID is "<phase>.<n>", such as "1.1"; unique in the runbook.

owner.description: Owner does the step; an action may name another owner.

summary.description: Summary introduces the step, in Markdown.

dependsOn.description:
DependsOn are the IDs of steps that must be done first. A step
depends on nothing implicitly, not even the step before it.

actions.description: Actions do the step, in order.

done.description:
Done is the sentence that says when the step is done, which its
checks implement as far as they can.

checks.description: Checks prove the step is done. They only read.

credentials.description: Credentials are the IDs of the credentials the step creates.

gate.description: Gate marks a decision or condition rather than work.

notes.description: Notes follow the actions, in Markdown.

Step.description: Step is one unit of work, done by its owner and proven by its checks.

timeout.description: Timeout is a Go duration, such as "10s"; 10s when empty.

UnreachableCheck.description: UnreachableCheck passes when a connection to the address fails within the timeout.

title: Runbook
description: An ordered procedure: phases of steps, each with an owner, its dependencies, the actions that do it, the sentence that says when it is done, and the checks that prove it.
